snippet.title: Hitman: The Complete First Season (2016) - PS4 Digital Download Launch Trailer | PS4,XBO,Stadia,PC
snippet.description:
Hitman: The Complete First Season is a stealth action game in the Hitman series, developed by IO Interactive and published by Square Enix. It was released in 2016 for PlayStation 4, Xbox One and Windows.

Hitman: The Complete First Season includes all six main episodes, along with the Prologue and Bonus Episode. Players can explore every location, complete challenges and opportunities, take on Escalation Contracts created by the studio and play Contracts created by the community.

The Complete First Season includes:

• Hitman: Prologue
• Hitman: Episode 1 - Paris
• Hitman: Episode 2 - Sapienza
• Hitman: Episode 3 - Marrakesh
• Hitman: Episode 4 - Bangkok
• Hitman: Episode 5 - Colorado
• Hitman: Episode 6 - Hokkaido
• Hitman: Bonus Episode

The physical Complete First Season release also includes bonus downloadable content, including the 3 Bonus Missions Pack featuring The Icon, A House Built on Sand and Landslide. Additional content includes the original soundtrack, a making-of documentary covering the game's development and launch, and the Hitman Requiem Blood Money Pack featuring the signature Blood Money white suit, white rubber duck and chrome ICA pistol.

The PlayStation 4 version also includes six additional exclusive missions known as The Sarajevo Six.
-------------------------------------------------------
Svenska:

Hitman: The Complete First Season är ett smyg- och actionspel i Hitman-serien, utvecklat av IO Interactive och utgivet av Square Enix. Spelet släpptes 2016 till PlayStation 4, Xbox One och Windows.

Hitman: The Complete First Season innehåller alla sex huvudepisoder samt Prologue och Bonus Episode. Spelaren kan utforska samtliga platser, klara utmaningar och möjligheter, ta sig an Escalation Contracts skapade av utvecklarna och spela Contracts som skapats av spelgemenskapen.

The Complete First Season innehåller:

• Hitman: Prologue
• Hitman: Episode 1 - Paris
• Hitman: Episode 2 - Sapienza
• Hitman: Episode 3 - Marrakesh
• Hitman: Episode 4 - Bangkok
• Hitman: Episode 5 - Colorado
• Hitman: Episode 6 - Hokkaido
• Hitman: Bonus Episode

Den fysiska Complete First Season-utgåvan innehåller även bonusmaterial som 3 Bonus Missions Pack med uppdragen The Icon, A House Built on Sand och Landslide. Därutöver ingår det ursprungliga soundtracket, en dokumentär om spelets utveckling och lansering samt Hitman Requiem Blood Money Pack med den ikoniska vita Blood Money-kostymen, en vit gummianka och en kromad ICA-pistol.

PlayStation 4-versionen innehåller även sex exklusiva bonusuppdrag kallade The Sarajevo Six.
